profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN. On its own site, Appian describes itself as providing AI automation for critical processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. It says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years and describes itself as a Leader in Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. The site lists uses including accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing, reconciliation, sourcing and contracts, purchasing, case resolution, onboarding, order fulfillment, and audit workflows, and it says onboarding time can be cut by up to 50%. It also references a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors and an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

The company's site presents its platform as a place where customers build AI-powered processes, with no-code app building and embedded AI agents that can extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. It points to process automation and artificial intelligence product pages and to legacy application modernization.

The record here lists no lawsuits and no MCP servers for Appian. Its law exposure is recorded in Virginia, with a count of 152.
